plan.title: Retire two superseded signing subkeys
plan.summary: Revokes the signing subkeys of 2022 and 2023 with the reason superseded, and rebuilds your public certificate. Nothing happens until you run it on the ceremony machine.

steps.title: Check the plan
steps.detail: ritueel compares the plan with the folder and asks you to type the first eight characters of the digest: c41e08b5.

steps.title: Open the key file
steps.detail: A passkey on root card one unwraps the key that opens the encrypted key file of your primary. The recovery key is not needed.

steps.title: Revoke the two subkeys
steps.detail: The primary revokes the signing subkey of 2022 and the signing subkey of 2023 with the reason superseded, dated on the day of the switch. Signatures made before that day keep their standing in strict verifiers.

steps.title: Rebuild the certificate
steps.detail: Writes your public certificate with the two revocations. Publishing it to a key server is left to you.
steps.whatChanges: A new public certificate in the folder

steps.title: Write the record
steps.detail: Writes the record of this ceremony and its transcript.
steps.whatChanges: One new record in the ledger
